7:4.text: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

7:5.text: And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers!"

7:9.text: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.

7:10.text: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.
